title: Camera For Streaming
description: Camera that automatically follows players in game.
body:
# **UNIQUE DEVELOPMENT**

Have you ever wanted to stream what's happening on your server? Randomly watch what players are doing from different angles and switch between players?

Luckily for you, there's my **INCREDIBLE** plugin that makes it possible!

I originally made this for my Paper server on version 1.21.1, but I think it should work on higher versions too.

_Plugin inspired by the Makoto server_

So, the plugin includes:

## **EASY CONFIGURATION**

The config allows you to:
- Instantly add a player who will automatically switch to camera mode upon joining to observe the server (works 50/50)
- Change the interval between switching camera angles and players!
- Also change the camera's position when no players are online

Even if no one is on the server, the camera will teleport to your specified coordinates and slowly rotate 360 degrees in a circle!

### **NOTICE**
The plugin does NOT help you stream — it doesn't include any streaming functionality. It allows you to turn a player into a camera so you can stream from their perspective using OBS or similar software.

### COMMANDS

- `/resetcamera <nickname>` — removes a player from the camera role  
- `/spectatorcameramod <nickname>` — sets a player as the camera  
- `/cameraspectate <nickname>/random` — if you enter a **player's nickname**, you’ll view only that player in camera mode without switching. If you write **random** instead, the camera will randomly teleport to different players and watch them

If you run into any issues, contact me on Telegram! @AlexsandrDeveloper  
_(Also message me if you're interested in buying the plugin’s source code)_
